newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai flood death toll up to 54, more farm damage.
newsitem.headline: Thai flood death toll up to 54, more farm damage.

text.p: The death toll from floods during the monsoon season this year in Thailand has jumped to 54 from 14 reported earlier this month, Interior Ministry officials said on Monday.
Flood damage to crops and property so far in this monsoon season, which started in late May, was estimated at 1.9 billion baht (US$76 million), they told Reuters.
Floods damaged 556,919 hectares (1.4 million acres) of farmland, 397,859 (990,000 acres) of which were rice fields, particularly in central and northeastern areas, the officials said.
Rains were easing and the flood situation was expected to improve in many areas, they added.
